Summary: Confirms the chosen implementation path stays within agreed design guardrails or has an approved ADR.
PassCriteria: Affected boundaries, risks, and irreversible choices are documented and either accepted as low risk or approved via ADR.
FailCriteria: Implementation relies on undocumented boundary changes, hidden coupling, or unresolved architectural conflict.
EscalationRule: Escalate to architecture governance before implementation passes the irreversible-threshold step.
